MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

3. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 7
   C. 36
   D. 6

4. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 29

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 22
   D. 88

7. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

10. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

11. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 46
   C. 23
   D. 120

13. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 100
   C. 10
   D. 50

14. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

15. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

17. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

18. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 1

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 77
   C. 36
   D. 18

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 105
   C. 22
   D. 30

22. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

23. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 3
   C. 15
   D. 17

24. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 8

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
